summary: Light-weight cross-route cost scan to identify quick wins for per-route unit economics. This sheet enumerates ~10 high-impact routes, with rough QPS, current per-1M-token cost, and estimated savings if routed to cheaper variants or operational fixes. Top immediate wins: 1) move nightly analytics to Dedicated batch pool (~$400k/1M tokens delta in per-1M estimate), 2) enable prefix caching on demo routes, 3) A/B kernel tuning for rerank route.
raw_notes:
